+package game
+
+import "testing"
+
+// TestFactoryNGDynamicAmountManaValueOfExiledThisWay covers ticket
+// engine.auto-dynamic-amount-mana-value-of-exiled-this-way-a737105295
+// (Ruinous Intrusion class): "Exile target artifact or enchantment. Put X
+// +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the mana value
+// of the permanent exiled this way." Exercises the real production
+// mechanism: executeExileEffect (the same function the "exile" atom case
+// calls) alongside recordExiledThisWayManaValue, then EvalDynamicAmountFull
+// (the same resolution entry point resolveDynamicAmountFull uses for every
+// amount_count-consuming effect, e.g. put_counters).
+func TestFactoryNGDynamicAmountManaValueOfExiledThisWay(t *testing.T) {
+	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+
+	artifact := NewCreature("Test Relic", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 1)
+	artifact.Type = "Artifact"
+	artifact.Types = []string{"Artifact"}
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(artifact)
+
+	spec := map[string]interface{}{"count": "exiled_this_way_mana_value"}
+
+	// Before any exile atom has run this resolution, the amount is unset.
+	if _, ok := gs.EvalDynamicAmountFull(spec, 0, nil, nil, nil); ok {
+		t.Fatalf("exiled_this_way_mana_value resolved before any exile atom ran")
+	}
+
+	targets := []Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: artifact.ID}}
+
+	// Mirror the "exile" ExecuteAbilityEffect case: record the target's
+	// mana value BEFORE it leaves the battlefield, then actually exile it.
+	gs.recordExiledThisWayManaValue(targets)
+	if err := gs.executeExileEffect(targets, -1); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("executeExileEffect: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	want := artifact.ManaCost.CMC()
+	got, ok := gs.EvalDynamicAmountFull(spec, 0, nil, nil, nil)
+	if !ok {
+		t.Fatalf("exiled_this_way_mana_value did not resolve after the exile atom ran")
+	}
+	if got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("exiled_this_way_mana_value = %d, want %d (exiled permanent's mana value)", got, want)
+	}
+
+	// Consume-once: reading again must NOT return the same value a second
+	// time, guarding against a later unrelated resolution seeing a stale
+	// value from a spell that exiled something but never consumed it.
+	if _, ok := gs.EvalDynamicAmountFull(spec, 0, nil, nil, nil); ok {
+		t.Fatalf("exiled_this_way_mana_value resolved a second time; must be consumed once")
+	}
+}
